page.layout: One printed page. Full-width dedication heading at top (title block, centred). Below it one column of running text with a historiated woodcut initial L at left; a marginal note in the right margin beside the first lines ("Luc.1.2. 3.4.5."). Catchword "q 2" and signature at the foot right area.

main_text.head: ¶ ILLVSTRISS. COMITIBVS, EQVITIBVS AVRATIS, SACRI REGII SENATVS CONSILIARIIS HONORATISS. dominis suis clementiss. Comiti WARWICENSI: Comitiq; LECESTRENSI, Oxoniensis Academiæ Cancellario dignissimo, Gratiam & pacem a Domino.
main_text.p: LVCAS INTER scrip-tores θεοπνεύστος non ignobilis (Comites illustrissimi) historiam quam omnibus numeris absolutam de Christi ipsiusq; apostolorum dictis & factis contexuit, maturo certè & prorsus divino consilio, praestantissimi Theophili nomine insigniuit. Cuius consilij ratio duplex ni fallor existit. Prior erat quam ipse verbis suis clarissimè proposuit; ut Theophilus certitudinem indubitatem agnoscat, eorum omnium in quibus prius fuerat institutus. Posterior vero & praecipua, ex ipsius tum verbis, tum instituto, nō obscurè erui & indagari potest. Nam quum ille, cùm ad rerum omnium veritatem plenam, sanctì spiritus fide, & afflatu, tum ad ordinis, & orationis structuræ elegantiam & gratiamLuc.1.2. 3.4.5.

page.notes: Woodcut initial L within a decorative border. Marginal note at right beside first lines. Some words are uncertain in the italic and black-letter Greek; the first word of the page is printed as LVCAS with an initial woodcut letter.
